newsitem.title: UK: Refco says client trade unhurt by Italy unit news.
newsitem.headline: Refco says client trade unhurt by Italy unit news.

text.p: U.S. brokerage concern Refco Group said on Monday that client trading was not adversely affected after its 50/50 Italian joint venture, Refco Italia, received a 60-day suspension from Italian regulators on Friday.

"Refco Group noted that client trading was neither interrupted nor adversely affected by the regulatory action since the accounts of Italian customers are carried directly on the books of other affiliates," the company said in a statement.
These affiliates included Refco Inc and Refco Overseas Limited.
Italian stock market regulator Consob said on Friday it suspended licensed broker Refco Italia for two months for a series of violations.
Refco Italia was alleged to have told clients it was authorised to act as a depositary for funds managed by third parties even though it was not authorised to do so.

A Consob statement said Refco Italia was "structurally slanted towards the interest of the group to which it belongs." It said this meant that, in effect, unathorised foreigners were directly conducting brokerage in Italy through Refco Italia.
Refco Group said Refco Italia had been in discussions with authorities relating to the appropriate structure for handling Italian institutional clients in global futures markets.
"Refco Italia believed it had at all times operated in accordance with procedures approved and authorised by appropriate Italian regulatory authorites," the company said.
It said Refco Italia would work with Italian authorities to insure that the operating structure of Refco Italia continued to meet all applicable requirements.
